title: BUILT CoLAB concludes its participation in the Sustainable Stone project by transferring the developments to the CESMINERAL Hub

content:
BUILT CoLAB has concluded its participation in Agenda Sustainable Stone, having transferred the digital developments created throughout the project to the CESMINERAL Hub – Centre for Research into Mineral Resources, in Porto de Mós, thereby ensuring their continuity and accessibility to the natural stone sector.

Among the key outcomes now available is the Moodle platform, which brings together the content, courses, support materials and training resources developed throughout the Agenda. This platform serves as a central hub for accessing the knowledge produced, enabling companies, technicians and other professionals to continue to benefit from the methodologies and tools created as part of the project.

This initiative reinforces the commitment to the ongoing professional development of the natural stone sector, ensuring that the results achieved remain accessible and can continue to have an impact beyond the duration of the Sustainable Stone Agenda.

In the same context, the Virtual Reality solutions developed by BUILT CoLAB – namely EditorRV and VisualizadorRV – have also been implemented. These tools are now ready for use in future demonstrations, learning activities and technological experimentation, helping to enhance immersive training content and promote digital skills within the sector.

With this move to the CESMINERAL Hub, BUILT CoLAB is further consolidating its provision of innovative solutions that support education, skills development and the modernisation of the natural stone value chain, reinforcing the legacy of the Sustainable Stone Agenda and its practical value within the sector’s ecosystem.
